title: Multimodal Knowledge Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Linked text, images, audio, video, diagrams, and extracted metadata in one knowledge store. The Multimodal Knowledge Database stores knowledge that does not fit in text alone: an image of a circuit with its schematic description, an audio clip with its transcript and analysis, a video with chapter summaries, a diagram with its structured data. Each record links the media to extracted metadata — what is in it, what it means, where it came from — so images, audio, and video become as searchable and citable as text.
capabilities: Media records: image, audio, video, diagram with format and technical metadata
Extraction pipelines: OCR, transcription, object detection, chapter segmentation
Cross-modal links: text descriptions anchored to image regions and audio timestamps
Metadata schemas per media type with required and optional fields
Search across modalities: find images by text description and vice versa

title: Multimodal Knowledge Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Media model: each record = {media_ref (hash + location), type, technical metadata (dimensions, duration, codec, sample rate), extractions[], links[]}. Extraction types: OCR (text + bounding boxes), transcription (text + word timestamps), detection (labels + boxes/timestamps), summarization (chapters + keyframes). Cross-modal linking: a text span anchors to [image region | time range]; the link carries the anchorer's confidence. Integrity: SHA-256 of the media file stored at ingest; re-verify on access. Metadata standards: Dublin Core basics (title, creator, date) plus type-specific fields. Search: text index over all extractions + embedding index over media for similarity search.

title: Multimodal Knowledge Database — Execution: runnable tool
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Runnable workflow: the ingest pipeline computes the file hash, extracts technical metadata, runs the extraction suite, and assembles the record; the anchor linker attaches text claims to media segments; the integrity checker re-verifies hashes; the cross-modal searcher finds media by text query over extractions. Demos execute ingest on synthetic media descriptors, anchor linking, integrity verification, and cross-modal search.

demo.title: Execution: identity resolution matching
demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

title: Multimodal Knowledge Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tests: hash test (tampered files detected); extraction-schema test (all required fields present); anchor test (every claim links to a real segment); search test (known items retrieved). Limitations: extraction quality varies by media quality; timestamps are approximate; embeddings for media are coarse. Every extraction carries confidence and the extractor version.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
